_comment: Ratified per-asset overrides (review/32 §7). The pipeline merges `role`/`type`/`footprint` into the generated manifest.json. `desktopRect` (PR 080 B3) is read LIVE from THIS file by the desk renderer (getDesktopRect) — the normalized {x,y,w,h} sub-rectangle of the trimmed sprite covering ONLY the desk's top surface (EXCLUDING the chair), where the occupant identity tile is drawn; retuning a rect is a one-line edit here with no rebuild. Rects measured from the 640px art (chair sits at the front/bottom ~lower 40%).
